findings.detail: No independent real sensor or camera dataset is evaluated

interpretation: Integrity and synthetic shortcut checks cannot establish bias-free data

sensor_plugin_verification_scope.source: Current source and recorded source hash are checked independently
sensor_plugin_verification_scope.library: Recorded binary hash/schema checked; binary need not be present in audit container
sensor_plugin_verification_scope.loaded_library: Producer verifies the loaded gzserver path/inode at acquisition; audit does not repeat a live process check

sensor_completion.split_method: Independent operating families, assigned before samples; all labels mixed within each family

vision_plugin_verification_scope.source: Current source and recorded source hash are checked independently
vision_plugin_verification_scope.library: Recorded binary hash/schema checked; binary need not be present in audit container
vision_plugin_verification_scope.loaded_library: Producer verifies the loaded gzserver path/inode at acquisition; audit does not repeat a live process check

vision_completion.label_method: Projected boundary of the same Gazebo primitive definitions; no near-plane crossings or clipping
vision_completion.realism: Synthetic surface visual proxies; no real-factory generalization claim
vision_completion.split_method: Independent geometry and rendering families; shuffled class acquisition inside each family

vision_render_gate.method: Independent raw PNG pixel comparison, with explicit per-edge rounding tolerance

vision_bulk_render_gate.method: Every defect row: independent raw PNG pixels plus manifest and learning-label alignment
